en: Crop substitution is unavailable in the first two plan negotiations.
A day off can be made a working day from the third year onward.
You may revise the plan in January without losing reputation, up to three times per epoch.
Crop substitution is not allowed in the first two plan discussions; delivery amounts may change by 10% in either direction.
The district takes one and a half times as long as usual to consider your requests.

In summer, you can invite factory comrades: a toolmaker, a blacksmith and a lathe operator. Each visit, they repair one horse-drawn implement or cart. The farm provides food and lodging. They will return if they were well fed and housed last time.

In summer, you can invite an instructor, a newspaperman and the manager of a hunting reserve. They help process one allocation request out of turn; the full points are still spent. The farm provides food and lodging. They will return if they were well fed and housed last time.

In summer, you can invite old comrades: a farrier, a riding trainer and a veterinary assistant. They help with the horses and bring a cavalry horse culled from the regiment: one per visit, no more than three per epoch. The farm provides food and lodging. They will return if they were well fed and housed last time.

In summer, you can invite former business contacts: a freight agent, a procurement agent and a railway buffet worker. They bring goods unavailable in the district: one lot of glass, roofing, nails or salt, no larger than a district lot. The farm provides food and lodging. They will return if they were well fed and housed last time.

In summer, you can invite friends from your former farm: a senior milkmaid, a calf keeper and a vegetable grower. They train one woman worker, up to the experienced level. The farm provides food and lodging. They will return if they were well fed and housed last time.
Before acceptance: {heads} head died for lack of feed ({share}% of herd). After the acceptance year, annual hunger deaths of 14% or more of the herd mean trial.
During the muddy season, the trip takes two days. Depart at 8:00, return the next morning: {return}. The farm runs without your direction until you return. Travel?
The Worker cannot substitute crops in the first two negotiations. A ±10% change to a plan position is available.
No village orders are accepted until you return. Standing assignments remain in effect.
From now on, the usual cost applies.
